name: event-sourced conceptual model
wording: its events: versions of the purpose, each bounded context's description and each concept, each with its reason; its projections: the conceptual model and the history; kept with the project, starting empty, its events joining with the change they belong to; never the work; append-only because it offers only appending, never by refusing a change to the project's version history; an event a reader doesn't know is read past and reported, never refusing the rest
reason: Comparing the readings: the design held that the record is append-only because it offers only appending, which is why nothing refuses a change to the version history; the version before stated the consequence without its cause.
